name: Sample Panel
description: Reference implementation of a plugin-shipped UI panel: an HTML page rendered inside the app (Plugins page → Panel) with the injected theme variables and the MyAgentHost bridge. Copy this shape when a model needs to add a real screen, not just a tool.
author: MyAgent

prompt.text: The sample-panel plugin is the reference for UI plugins. It ships three surfaces: `ui.panel` (panel.html, opened from the Plugins page or from a slot chip), a composer slot (`where:"composer", type:"chips"` — buttons above the input box) and a message slot (`where:"message", type:"html"` — card.html under the newest message). Chip items either call `plugin.action(name, fn)` or open a panel with `panel`; slot HTML gets window.MyAgentHost with theme()/toast()/call(action,args)/insert(text)/send(text)/openPanel(id)/args(). Copy these three files as the template when the user asks for new in-app UI: write the html/css/js, declare `ui`, then call plugin_reload — no rebuild, no restart.

tools.name: sample_panel_info
tools.description: Describe the sample UI panel plugin (what it demonstrates, which bridge calls it uses, how relative assets resolve).
